title: Bitcoin’s $94,000 Weekly Close Test: Economic Ninja’s Warning
description:
Bitcoin’s $94,000 weekly close test anchors The Economic Ninja’s warning that the rebound may be a false breakout. We recap the channel’s challenge to bottom claims around $85,000 and its historical chart comparison, credited to @0x_chefy. Next come its possible brief $29,000 panic scenario, predicted $149,000 next peak and expectation of larger percentage swings in XRP. Finally, we cover its argument that weak stock-market breadth could pressure crypto, gold and silver. Our take for everyday Americans: excitement and anxiety can rush financial decisions, so protect money needed for bills and pause before acting.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#TheEconomicNinja #EconomicNinjaBitcoin #Bitcoinweeklyclose #Bitcoin94000resistance #Bitcoinfalsebreakout
